# Phase 4 — Distribution

[GENESIS §14 Phase 4](GENESIS.md). Wires up `dist` (formerly cargo-dist),
release workflow, Homebrew tap / Scoop bucket / winget manifests, code
signing + macOS notarization, `maru update` self-update, and mdBook
docs site.

Exit criterion: `brew install <tap>/maru`, `scoop install maru`,
`winget install maru`, `curl -sSL ... | sh` all work on a fresh machine.

This phase has external dependencies the bot can't satisfy alone:
publishing to Homebrew / Scoop / winget requires separate repositories
or PRs, and macOS notarization + Windows code signing require certs
the user holds. We scaffold the in-repo pieces and document the manual
steps in `docs/notes/phase-4-handoff.md`.
